user_saw: With one agent selected and My sessions chosen, the Control UI sidebar listed conversations and pins belonging to other agents.
summary: Always passes the selected agentId in owner-filtered sidebar session queries and filters personal pins and sections to the selected agent, keeping Show all and rail shortcuts cross-agent.
reasoning: The removed line `agentId: ownerId ? undefined : agentId` came from f9cb55fd00c4 (#170865), which deliberately extended an existing cross-agent My sessions scope (`ownerId === selfId ? undefined : agentId`) to every explicit owner, so owner filters ignoring the agent was intended design. The fix PR says the contributor 'explicitly chose agent scope first, then owner filtering' and adds new docs for that scope, making this a product decision rather than a break of working behavior.
